task.notes: Cardiomyocytes from E9.5 to E10.5. A known feature: the E9.5 -> E10.5 transition was read by the pre-registered direction readout and M1's diagnostic (diag_v1) with Feng's E9.5 -> E14.5 direction, so a gain here alone proves little; see the rule in experiments/harness/TRIES.md T13-T18.

floor.what: the organisers' floor: the reference's 10% working copy (copy_last or wt_identity)

b0.what: B0 (feat-009): T1 chamber-only copy plus damped momentum; T2 copy plus damped momentum or bracket interpolation, both in count space

b0_scope.what: T1 chamber-only copy without a shift (B0's composition alone)

lp_proxy.what: try T13: Feng's E14.5 -> E18 direction at the step's share of its bracket, on B0's chamber copy (the stand-in for M1's real E9.5 -> E14.5 direction)
lp_proxy.fraction: the step's share of the bracket (target day - reference day) / 4; no momentum, no other change
lp_proxy.held_flat: the pre-registered list (named genes alone where its pool rule's stages are not inputs)

lp_cflip.what: try T14, control Cflip: lp_proxy's direction negated
lp_cflip.fraction: the step's share of the bracket (target day - reference day) / 4; no momentum, no other change
lp_cflip.held_flat: the pre-registered list (named genes alone where its pool rule's stages are not inputs)

lp_cperm.what: try T15, control Cperm: lp_proxy's direction permuted across genes within deciles of the group's mean CP10k (one permutation, seed 20261110)
lp_cperm.fraction: the step's share of the bracket (target day - reference day) / 4; no momentum, no other change
lp_cperm.held_flat: the pre-registered list (named genes alone where its pool rule's stages are not inputs)
